title: Hytale seed explorer fidelity fixture (v1)
description: Small, versioned (seed, coordinate) -> world-facts cases. Provenance is mandatory on every case; a case without an honest source is worse than no case.

world_assets.description: World folder + provider version and/or pack hash the cases were produced with, e.g. 'Default@testdata/Default@0.0.0'.

seed.description: Exact seed input text, kept verbatim.

y.description: Optional slice height for cases that pin a specific Y.

biome.description: Biome name as the generator reports it; null = not recorded (authoritative pending).

height.description: Surface height as the game shows it; null = not recorded.

surface_block.description: Registry block name at the surface; null = not recorded.

source.description: golden-chunks: Java dumper output (game-authoritative blocks/fluids). worldgen-test: Rust generator output (self-consistency only). live-server: recorded in the real game. pending-live: value still unverified, do not trust.
